QuestInfo.name: Gabrielle's Request
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2154004##k, who is being held hostage at the #b#m310050000##k in the Mine, says she has something she'd like to test.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154004# says she would like to help the town any way she can while being held hostage. Lately, she's been eavesdropping on the Black Wings' conversation and collecting information. According to what she's heard, #r#o7150004##k has a built-in chip, and by studying this chip, she says the Black Wings' technology can be revealed. As a favor to #p2154004#, find #b#t4032768##k and take it over to #b#p2152018##k. \n\n#i4032768# #t4032768# #b#c4032768# / 20#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2152018# was surprised to receive the #t4032768#, but still seemed determined.

0.0: I feel bad being helpless here while the people of Edelstein are struggling and fighting so hard. Truth is, the Black Wings don't pay me much heed. They have to keep me safe and healthy for me to have value as a hostage...
0.1: I just wish there were something I could do to help the people of Edelstein. I've been eavesdropping on the Black Wings, but I'll need your help if I want what I've learned to be of any use.

yes.0: This information is about the #r#o7150004#s#k. Unlike other robots, the chips inside the #o7150004#s won't break even when they are destroyed.
yes.1: So if you take about #b20 #t4032768#s#k and study them, you'll be able to learn something about the Black Wing's technology. Please obtain the #t4032768#s and take them to #p2152018# in town. I'm sure that he'll know what to do.

no.0: You're the only one who can help me. Please reconsider.

1.0: What is it? It's not smart to talk to me. People don't like me... Hmm? These are...#t4032768#? Where did you get these? Why are you giving them to me?

yes.0: #p2154004# asked you to deliver this to me? How...? Ah, I see. She is fighting for Edelstein, even while imprisoned... I am embarrassed of myself...for having been hostile to the town on her account.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p2152018##k yet? If you get #b20 #t4032768#s#k, please deliver them to #p2152018#. He doesn't know much about robots but I'm sure he has connections with people who do.

item.0: What is it.... It's not a good idea to talk to me.
